repo_url.description: GitHub/GitLab repo if open source, else empty

data_sources.description: What it reads, e.g. Claude Code transcripts, Codex sessions, Cursor transcripts, git history, editor telemetry

longitudinal_analysis.description: Does it track behavior/metrics over time rather than one-shot snapshots?

proposes_config_changes.description: Does it suggest or apply edits to AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, skills, rules, or memory files?

evidence_cited.description: Do its outputs cite specific sessions/excerpts as evidence?

detects_harmful_config.description: Does it identify counterproductive skills, plugins, or rules?

overlap_with_our_concept.description: High = analyzes agent transcripts AND recommends config changes; medium = does one of those; low = adjacent

differentiation_notes.description: What it does NOT do that our concept does, or vice versa

unclaimed_gaps.description: Capabilities from the research brief that no found tool provides
